sail

A thirty-four foot sloop, a sea built out of twenty-one Gerstner components, and a rig that answers the way a rig answers. W, S trim the main, arrow keys steer, P hands it to the pilot, H is the key list — and Esc → MISSIONS → SAILING 101 walks you round her, one control at a time.

0%

fetching the game…

Needs a browser with WebGPU — Chrome, Edge, or Safari 18 and up. The dials the desk build reads from the environment are on the query string here:

  • ?wind=32&sea=built — a gale that has already blown up
  • ?hour=19&cover=0.8 — the evening, overcast
  • ?ink=1 — the sea drawn rather than photographed
  • ?seed=7 — the same day back again

The real thing is a single file for Mac and Windows and it does not need a tab: the latest release.
